entities.justification: Appointed as attorney/plenipotentiary in the document: 'constituerunt et solemniter ordinaverunt in suam veram legitimam ac indubitatam Plenipotentem Honestum Thomam Szyrek Calceatorem Suburbanum Leopoliensem'.
City referenced in the text ('Suburbanum Leopoliensem', 'Civis Leopoliensis'). Matches known corpus entity Lwów.
Deceased blacksmith whose estate is being claimed: 'post obitum Honesti olim Nicolai Suszka Ferrifabri Suburbani Leopoliensem'.
Relative/constituent mentioned as 'praefati Martini dwe affinis siquidem sororem illius germanam in matrimonio habuit'. Matches known entity PER-0391: Martinus Suburbanus.
Relative/constituent mentioned as 'dicti vero Pauli Ząbek fratrem patruelem'.
Date formula referencing the date established earlier in the session, matching known corpus date alias.

Party involved in the quietatio: 'Quietatio Anna Sapiżina', 'Honesta Anna primarum Famati olim Sapiha ad praesens vero secundarum nuptiarum Honesti Fabii Lary coniunx legitima'. Matches known entity PER-0026: Anna.
Goldsmith and citizen of Lviv appearing before the court: 'Comparens personaliter Famatus Nicolaus Kurołtowski haereditarius raterki Aurifaber Civis Leopoliensis tanqe gener et Plenipotens'.
Mother-in-law represented by Kurołtowski: 'Plenipotens Honestae Catherinae Czygoszowa ad praesens peregre abientis'.
First deceased husband of Anna: 'primarum Famati olim Sapiha'.
Second current husband of Anna: 'secundarum nuptiarum Honesti Fabii Lary coniunx legitima'.
